title: The Defender section of test-suite-speed.md ties its figures to -Raw output the run never used and backs its derived third row with an unrelated remainder
goal: kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md's Defender section states the duration unit only as the unit of -Raw output, without implying the figures came from a -Raw run (the recorded command has no -Raw: the figures are the formatted TimeSpans in seconds), and its third group's 2.0 s is named as derived from the total without the per-process remainder offered as corroboration (that remainder covers other scans). Found by the SP-kyvu526t review.

run: import sys,pathlib;s=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('## Defender')[1];bad=('figures here are those durations' in s) or ('gives the same remainder' in s);print('misleading wording present:',bad);sys.exit(int(bad))

repro_reason: The defect is the report's wording: the recording is a one-off .etl outside the repository, so the repro checks the two misleading phrases are gone.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 3 of 13, "Benchmarks: no unplanned paid run, dated model keys, report wording"); it blocks no fitness test and no real user reported it, so it sits in a late sprint of the sequence. Premise: the repro run 2026-10-10 prints 'misleading wording present: True' and exits 1: reproduces.
